reviews.comment: Pretty solid class overall. A good amount of assignments, but they require real effort to get a good grade. It focuses on technical writing like resumes, which is actually useful. A bit more work than expected, but overall a good class that teaches skills you'll use.

While the class is pretty weighted towards the final group project, which I don't like, its still a pretty easy course. It is essentially three major projects and a few quick-writes. She will provide feedback on all of the project drafts and makes writing interesting.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Heneks is one of the best professors I have ever had! She is super understanding and funny, and her class is actually interesting! She's not a super hard grader but make sure to keep up with the readings because she gives short pop quizzes!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: If you hate group projects like I do, do not take. Every month there is one project due, the first 2 are solo and the last 2 are group projects. All constitute a major portion of your grade. GP is 4 people and her directions can be vague, they're designed to prep you for a career, but as a non traditional student I can confidently say they won't.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: You have to attend & read/watch the material. There's quizzes to check you're keeping up & critically thinking & a couple group projects with presentations. Other than that it's all just discussion & I thought it was interesting. It's not a hard class, it's an easy A with minimal effort. The projects were not bad just pick good groups. She's nice!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Heneks is a great professor with a few annoying quirks in her classes. Although the discussions she leads are often thought-provoking, they're also usually ideologically slanted. There are also random quizzes and a few group projects. Still, she grades fairly and the class is interesting. Read the syllabus and decide from there.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: She is amazing. If you need an English credit to graduate please go out of your way to take her ENGL 206 class. Not once was I stressed in there. A lot of your grade is in group projects but they are so easy. Can be a little too political sometimes but it's not a huge deal, just don't listen to that part
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Caring--Respected

reviews.comment: Dr Heneks is amazing and my favorite professor i've ever had. Her class is mainly discussions and pop quizzes. She is such a fun professor and you can really tell she loves what she does!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've ever had. All you have to do to get an A, is read and watch what she assigns. She's a super chill grader if she feels like you're engaging with the content which isn't hard bc her syllabus includes super fun texts. Some forms of text included films like Get Out, poems, scripts, novels, short stories, etc.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: About half of the class was group projects. Some of the directions for projects were a little bit difficult to understand/confusing wording, but once I figured everything out I felt like the project themselves were not very difficult. I would just say that the class was time consuming for me personally, especially toward the end of the semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Heneks is a very smart and nice professor. The course was well organized, and she had group projects instead of essays. There are a fair amount of quizzes over the assigned readings, so it's not just an easy A. But it's not overly hard, either; Dr. Heneks is fair and understanding in her grading. Overall, the course was a good experience.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is mostly group projects, but she gives ample amount of time in class to complete these projects, so you will have little to no homework. Attendance is part of the grade, but you can skip a couple classes before it starts to affect your grade. Overall, it's an easy class if you do the work.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Heneks' class! Honestly, as long as you do the readings (which were overall pretty fun to read!) and participate in the discussions in class and show that you are actively listening, you should be okay. The projects are hard to understand as far as what exactly she wants but not too bad. The readings were great!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Respected

reviews.comment: I personally didn't love her class. Despite it being English, she didn't have us do any essays because of AI. The projects were not fulfilling and often rushed through presentations. But it was easy if you go to class and do the readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Dr. Heneks is great! I took the summer class so it was really fast-paced but she was aware of that and made it the best it could be for her students. Pop quizzes are tough but doable and she gives a good amount of grades so getting an A is definitely attainable. Overall great professor :)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: This class is good if you are willing to put in effort and attend class consistently. If you do, your grades will reflect that. However, she docks points for unexcused absences and you do have to put in the work for an A. I appreciated the flipped classroom structure and the projects weren't too difficult. Overall a good class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Heneks presents all of the criteria for her class within the first few lectures and she follows those rules throughout the semester, without wavering. She will never bend the rules or make acceptations. If you show up and do the work, you will do great! But, if you are prone to sleeping in, DON'T TAKE
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Really nice prof but you have to show you care and participate! If she sees you are trying hard, she will go the extra mile to help any way she can!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Go to class and make sure to actually read! The discussions are really fun if you've read, but if not, good luck following. She makes the class really fun and enjoyable. There are a ton of pop quizzes, but she grades those really easy. The papers are graded more harshly, but if you go to her office hours, she will help so much!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took her for Engl 373; it is very clear she cares about what she teaches. Pop quizzes about once a week so you have to do the readings. Make sure you follow guidelines and rubric or your grades will see the effect. Attendance is required, but she makes it easy to go to class. She is big on class-group discussions.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: LOVE Dr. Heneks! Very project based learning vibes but really gets into it with you and is clear about exactly what she wants. A definitely doable
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Gave me a B after I had missed some classes, all of which I communicated that I was sick. Did not tell me I needed proof and several points were deducted at the end of the semester. I had gotten A's on most assignments. Rude, unhelpful, unnecessarily hard grader for an entry level English course.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: I hate English, but Dr. Heneks made this course amazing.  She really cares about her students, and makes an effort to help you understand the course.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Heneks! 210 is mostly group based and she will give you feedback. Not a lot of outside work at all. Reading quizzes every now and then, pretty easy. She grades strictly but reasonably and she will answer questions about what she wants if you ask.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: This class wasn't hard on a weekly basis but if you didn't show up for class it made the tests harder. Lots of readings and movies, most were interesting but was a lot. Tests were time consuming but easier if you did the readings and went to class. Class discussions were interesting but remember the discussions since most test questions are about

I love math and have always hated English. I am not a good writer either. This class helped me SO MUCH! She took over the class after our original professor got sick. Her lectures were so interesting and informative. I didn't read one book and I made an A. She goes over everything in the lectures and just wants you to participate and understand.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: I was forced to take this professor because the professor I had choose got sick and was not able to teach that semester. Lectures are boring and long, reading list is HUGE and the books are boring. Most of your grade is based on the exams and her and her TA grade extremely hard and unfairly. She is unresponsive to emails and is unwilling to help u
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Obviously in this class you have to read the books assigned. It is a lot of reading, not going to lie, but it's doable in my opinion. I also didn't think we had to write that much, only a midterm and final research paper. She's not that hard of a grader, too. The discussions in class were always really stimulating and she is very nice and helpful!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: This class was okay, but I had to buy a textbook that we used maybe three times on top of four other books. She gives good feedback if you go to her office hours, and she is such a nice person. However, the syllabus says no points would be taken off for attendance until the final grade, yet points were taken off in participation for attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS
